findings.finding: Unverified actual-looking names and opening hours replaced by explicitly generic fictional venue identities, null hours and null addresses. Displayed routes, forms, messages, products and closure notices are hypothetical scene facts.
Park retained; Community Staff corrected to existing Park Staff. Other existing supported venue/job pairings retained.

Nurse explains wording and records reported symptoms without diagnosis or treatment advice. Police preserves message facts without certifying fraud or investigation outcome. Government staff does not determine document sufficiency. Postal staff does not guarantee intact delivery or infer unknown address details. Bank handles pre-execution questions without making a transfer. Station/park descriptions make no real local route or service claim.
